description.title: Description
description.remarks: The description of the reason for work.

functn.title: Function
functn.remarks: Describes the function responsible for this reason for work. When you create a new reason for work, the application assigns a default value of MAINTENANCE.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: The date and time when the reason for work was created or was changed through the Change Status action.

displaysequence.title: Display Sequence
displaysequence.remarks: A numeric value that indicates the sequence in which you want this reason for work column to display on the Priority Matrix report. For example, if you type 1, the report displays this reason for work as the first column in the Reason for Work section of the matrix.

rfwnum.title: Reason for Work
rfwnum.remarks: The identifier of the reason for work. The value of the identifier must be unique for an organization and function.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The status of the reason for work. When you create a new reason for work, the application assigns it a status of DRAFT. You can change this value only through the Change Status action.
